# Mario Super Sluggers

## Where is the options page?

You can read through all the options and generate a YAML [here](../player-options).

## What does randomization do to this game?

Every character recruit, interactable object, and key item in Challenge Mode counts as a check and will send a random
item. The ability to change between day and night is also randomized into the pool.

## What is the goal of Mario Super Sluggers when randomized?

The goal condition can be chosen from any of the following:
- Defeat Bowser Monsters: Unlock a full team and the day-night cycle, then defeat the Bowser Monsters in a game.
- Play Badge: Unlock and win all minigames (including Toy Field).
- Friend Badge: Recruit all characters.
- Star Badge: Have star status on every character, then defeat the Bowser Monsters in a game.

# Mario Super Sluggers Randomizer Setup Guide

## Required Software
- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest)
- [The Mario Super Sluggers APWorld](https://github.com/MarioManTAW/Archipelago/releases)
- [MSS AP Patcher](https://github.com/MarioManTAW/mss-ap-patcher/releases/)
- [Dolphin Emulator](https://dolphin-emu.org/download/)
- A dumped North American copy of Mario Super Sluggers in ISO, CISO, or WBFS format

## Optional Software
- [Mario Super Sluggers Tracker](https://github.com/MarioManTAW/MarioSuperSluggersAPTracker/releases/)
  - Requires [PopTracker](https://github.com/black-sliver/PopTracker/releases/)

## How to play

First, you need a room to connect to. For this, you or someone you know has to generate a game. This will not be
explained here, but you can check the [Archipelago Setup Guide](https://archipelago.gg/tutorial/Archipelago/setup_en).

- Use the MSS AP Patcher and the .apmss file you should have received from the host to generate a patched game file.
- Open the Mario Super Sluggers Client from Archipelago Launcher.
- Open Dolphin and launch the game file generated by the patcher.
  - **Important!** Do not load into a save file that already has Challenge Mode save data, as this will send checks
    prematurely.
- Write your host connection info in the box at the top of the client and press enter.
- Write your slot/player name into the box at the bottom and press enter. If needed, enter the room password.
- Once you are connected, enter Challenge Mode and start a new game.
- When reconnecting, it is fine to reuse the same save file but both the game and client need to be closed between
  sessions.

## Troubleshooting

There are failsafes in place to ensure the game does not softlock by choosing an impossible mission. If an issue with
missions does pop up, however, you can use the `/reset_mission` command in the client to select a random safe mission.

notes.text:
- Code patches have been moved from being applied at runtime by the client to the new [**MSS AP Patcher**](<https://github.com/MarioManTAW/mss-ap-patcher/releases>). This should make the game more stable and less susceptible to issues when connection steps happen out of order.
  - This means that **patching is now mandatory**, be sure to follow the new setup steps. Additionally, this update is **not backwards-compatible** with older APWorld versions so please finish any ongoing multiworlds before updating.
- New option: **Randomize Error Items**. Randomizes which 3 error items you have access to at the start.
- New option: **Randomize Stats**. Shuffles stats between characters. Pitching, batting, fielding, and running stats are shuffled independently.
- New option: **Randomize Puzzles**. Randomizes the lever puzzle in Mario Stadium and the hedge maze in Peach Ice Garden.
- New option: **Randomize Quiz**. Adds additional question sets for Blue Yoshi's quiz, including sluggers, math, and meme.
- New option: **Randomize Text**. Shuffles text/dialogue throughout the game, excluding relevant UI/tutorial text.

Check out the [setup guide](<https://github.com/MarioManTAW/Archipelago/blob/sluggers/worlds/mario_super_sluggers/docs/setup_en.md>) for setup procedures (this has changed!). You may also find the [PopTracker pack](<https://github.com/MarioManTAW/MarioSuperSluggersAPTracker/releases>) helpful.
